input.answer: Canada lost about 68.3 thousand jobs from August to September 2026 (seasonally adjusted). Employment fell from 21,173.1 thousand in August to 21,104.8 thousand in September. The change is 21,104.8 − 21,173.1 = −68.3 thousand, or −0.3% (−68.3 / 21,173.1 = −0.32%). Figures are for employment, people 15 years and over, both sexes, from Table 14-10-0287.

answer_values.label: change_abs
answer_values.description: Change in seasonally adjusted employment, Canada, 15+, both sexes, August to September 2026 (21,104.8 − 21,173.1)

answer_values.label: change_pct
answer_values.description: Percent change in seasonally adjusted employment, August to September 2026 (−68.3 / 21,173.1)
